# VAIB Technical Tools

> Independent IT administration resources created and maintained by Vaibhav Kamra.

VAIB Technical Tools shares practical PowerShell scripts, Microsoft 365 administration resources, Linux utilities, security references and technical documentation for IT administrators.

- Website: https://vaibcc.github.io/free-it-administrator-tools-and-scripts/
- Creator: Vaibhav Kamra
- Personal website: https://vaib.cc
- Source repository: https://github.com/vaibcc/free-it-administrator-tools-and-scripts
- Languages: English and French
- Executable scripts: English source code in PowerShell and Bash

## Main sections

- Script library: searchable collection of published scripts with source code, requirements, permissions and download actions.
- Useful IT tools: curated official and open-source resources.
- Documentation: practical usage and security guidance.
- About: project information and creator profile.

## Important notes

- Scripts are provided as-is for technical assistance.
- Review and test all code before using it in production.
- Prefer least privilege and read-only operations.
- Script output may contain personal or infrastructure data.
- Website language selection does not translate executable source code.
- The website is an independent static project with no external platform account or hosted backend.

Created and maintained by Vaibhav Kamra. Visit https://vaib.cc for more information.
